description.translate: Twelve iron ingots will replace the guards and tool-rack braces. We are repairing a service station, not starting another engine. Keep that distinction clear. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

I supplied tools and fittings for his research expeditions. In return, The Ranker promised to help repair this outpost and keep its stores dependable. Each success brought another requisition. The repairs kept waiting. Useful machinery mattered to us long after an expedition had moved on.
